children: Flux reduces its block reward by 10%, from 14 to 12.6 FLUX per block, on 26 October 2026. The reduction takes effect when the network reaches block 3,071,200 and is the first annual cut one year after Proof of Node.
The smaller reward modestly reduces the rate of new FLUX issuance. Each block adds 1.4 fewer FLUX to the supply.

Tomorrow, 26 October, the Flux block reward drops 10%, from 14 to 12.6 FLUX per block, at block 3,071,200. This is the first annual reduction, one year after Proof of Node. The article covers what changes for each tier and the twenty-year schedule.

title: Flux: Block reward drops 10% to 12.6 FLUX - 26 Oct 2026
